records.run: Shen et al. 2020 (global fit A, computed)

selection.warning: Computed from the published global fit A (the paper shows only the time-integrated mass density, not this rate). Mass-growth convention (1-eps)/eps, so this is eps-dependent and is NOT the accretion rate L/(eps c^2) of Hopkins+07; fit A is constrained by data at 0<z<7 only.

definitions.radiativeEfficiencyQuote: Assuming a constant averaged radiative efficiency $\epsilon_{\rm r}\simeq 0.1$
definitions.bhadDefinition: rate of change of the SMBH mass density per unit proper time, (1-eps)/(eps c^2) * int L phi dlogL over 43 <= log L_bol <= 48 (the integrand of: \dfrac{{\rm d}\rho_{\rm BH}}{{\rm d}z}=\dfrac{1-\epsilon_{\rm r}}{\epsilon_{\rm r}c^{2}H(z)(1+z)})
definitions.luminosityRange: where we adopt $\log{L_{\rm min}}=43,\log{L_{\rm max}}=48$ here.

definitions.bhadDefinition: accretion-rate density L_bol-density/(eps c^2) with L_bol = eps Mdot c^2 (no (1-eps) factor; the factor was selected because only this form reproduces the paper's quoted rho_BH(z=0)=4.81e5 to 1%), luminosity density from integrating the QLF to L=0
